priceSnapshot.note: THE ENDDAY REDUCE GATE DID NOT FIRE, THE FLUSH LOW HELD ON A HIGHER LOW, AND THE TAPE HAS SPENT THE OVERNIGHT GRINDING BACK UP INTO ITS OWN SHORT CLUSTER. Endday printed 77,269.1 at 19:35 COT with a REDUCE gate at a settled 1H close below 76,380.0, an ADD gate at a settled 1H close above 78,230.0 and an invalidation at 75,559.5. Sequence since: the 01:00Z hour sold to 76,713.6 - 333.6 points ABOVE the reduce gate, so the gate was never reached, let alone closed through - and then the seven settled hours closed 77,205.1 / 77,012.9 / 77,328.3 / 77,560.6 / 77,553.8 / 77,658.8 / 77,612.8, six of them higher than the last. The 76,713.6 low is a HIGHER LOW against yesterday's 76,416.6 flush, by 297.0 points. The add gate was never in play either - the overnight high is 77,788.1, 441.9 points short of 78,230.0. Against endday, spot is +476.3 points, +0.62 percent; against the rolling 24h open of 78,723.3 the tape is -977.9 points, -1.24 percent. 24h high 78,803.3, 24h low 76,416.6. sessionRange below covers 00:35Z forward, the window this report inherits from endday.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE below 76,600.0. The level moves UP 220 points from the endday gate at 76,380.0 because the reference has changed: the overnight has produced a defended higher low at 76,713.6, and that low - not yesterday's 76,416.6 - is now the thing whose failure would mean something. 76,600.0 sits 113.6 points beneath it and, more importantly, beneath the 76,625 lower edge of the 76,750 bucket that just absorbed 1,480,643 USD of long liquidations in the 01:00Z hour. That placement is the rule the calibration record has been converging on for three sessions: put the gate BELOW live liquidation flow so it cannot be run and un-run. Distance from spot is 1,145.4 points, 2.62 hourly ATRs on a 436.5 reading, which is wide - deliberately so, because the honest lesson of the last two sessions is that this book will travel 900+ points inside an hour on a headline, and a gate inside that radius measures noise rather than thesis failure.

addIf.confirmation: A settled 1H CLOSE above 77,950.0. That price does three things at once: it clears the 77,788.1 overnight high, it clears the upper edge of the 77,750 bucket that has taken 456,180 USD of SHORT liquidations in the last six hours, and it closes above the 1H EMA50 at 77,925.9 - the second hourly moving average of the stack and the first one that has capped every bounce since the break. Distance is only 204.6 points, 0.47 hourly ATRs, and the tightness is intentional: the hourly EMA20 at 77,610.3 has already been reclaimed on a settled close, so the next real structural event is the EMA50, not something 900 points away. The gate at 78,230.0 that endday used was the EMA100; that is now the SECOND target, not the trigger.

decisionBox.changed: BIAS MOVES FROM BEARISH TO RANGE WITH A BEARISH TILT, CONFIDENCE EASES 5.25 TO 5.00, AND THE FUTURES HEDGE COMES OFF ON ITS OWN WRITTEN RULE. What improved, and it is most of the board: the 1H MACD histogram has FLIPPED POSITIVE at +61.47 against endday's -45.10, with the line lifting from -312.38 to -189.59; the 1H RSI has recovered 37.67 to 47.84; price has reclaimed the 1H EMA20 at 77,610.3 on a settled close (the 06:00Z hour closed 77,612.8) and is now 135.1 points above it; the 15m stack has turned outright constructive with price above the EMA20 and EMA50 and the MACD line above its signal at +78.32 / +73.26; price has reclaimed the 4H EMA50 at 77,622.8 and sits 122.6 points above it; funding has EASED from 0.0000900731748201 to 0.0000744604525652, so longs are paying less into a rising price rather than more into a falling one; and the low is a higher low. What did NOT improve, and it is why the tilt stays bearish rather than turning: the 1 September ETF print has been REVISED from the -35.3m endday reported to -236.5m on the completed Farside tape, a 6.7-fold larger outflow and the worst single day since 28 August; open interest has REBUILT 3.56 percent from 2,151,955,793.45 to 2,228,565,594.79 USD, so the leverage that was flushed out has been replaced and then some; the OKX retail long/short account ratio is unchanged at 1.30, still the crowded side; the 4H MACD histogram is still -114.69 and price is still 376.3 points under the 4H EMA20; and Brent at 95.38 with the 10-year at 4.804 percent leaves the macro backdrop exactly where it was. The POSITION line reads HOLD and that refers to the spot core, which is untouched. The change this session is in the FUTURES book: endday's own hedge note said a settled reclaim of the hourly EMA20 kills the thesis and should kill the hedge. That reclaim happened at 06:00Z. The short is closed at the rule rather than left to be stopped 54.6 points away at 77,800.0.

calibration.rollingRecord: ENDDAY GRADED: BOTH GATES CORRECTLY UNFIRED AND THE INVALIDATION HELD FOR THE FIRST TIME IN THREE SESSIONS. Endday set the reduce gate at 76,380.0 with price at 77,269.1. The lowest print of the window was 76,713.6 in the 01:00Z hour - 333.6 points ABOVE the level, so the gate was not reached and no settled 1H close came near it. UNFIRED, correctly: price at this report is 77,615.1 to 77,745.4, so a desk that had sold anywhere in that flush would be behind. The add gate at 78,230.0 was also correctly unfired against an overnight high of 77,788.1, 441.9 points short. The invalidation at 75,559.5 was never approached, which ends the two-session run in which the invalidation was breached on a wick and reclaimed - the endday decision to widen it to 3.78 hourly ATRs looks right after one night of evidence. The recommended resting stop at 76,380.0 was not filled. Running tally over the last four graded sessions: two gates fired (midnight 2026-09-01 hurt by 0.18 percent, morning 2026-09-01 helped by 0.18 percent), two correct abstentions (midday and endday 2026-09-01).
calibration.note: The placement rule now has a third data point and it is the cleanest one yet. Morning put its gate below live liquidation flow and it fired and paid. Midday put its gate at 77,000.0, price went 583 points through it, no settled close printed beneath it, and the confirmation rule kept the desk out of a bottom sale. Endday went further and placed the gate at 76,380.0, below every bucket that had taken fills - and price did not even reach it before turning. Three sessions, three different distances, and the two widest placements both avoided a bad sale. That is not proof the rule makes money; it is evidence the rule stops the desk from selling flushes, which is a different and more modest claim. The genuinely new finding this session concerns the HEDGE, not the gate. Endday opened a 70 USDT short and wrote its own kill condition into the rationale: a settled reclaim of the hourly EMA20 kills the thesis and should kill the hedge. The 06:00Z hour closed 77,612.8 against an EMA20 of 77,610.3. The condition was met by 2.5 points, and the honest thing is to act on a rule that is barely satisfied exactly as if it were comfortably satisfied - otherwise the rule is decoration. The hedge is closed at 77,745.4 for a small realised loss rather than left to be mechanically stopped 54.6 points higher. The counter-record to keep watching: this desk has now twice written a gate whose trigger was met within a handful of points, and both times the temptation was to wait one more bar.
